turns.content: I need help crafting a LinkedIn post for the Fujifilm X100VI. Here are three key facts: it has a 23mm f/2 lens, a hybrid autofocus system, and a compact design. Can you create a post that highlights these features?

I created the draft and validated it against the confirmed product facts and requested constraints.

Introducing the Fujifilm X100VI! This innovative camera features a 23mm f/2 lens, a hybrid autofocus system, and a compact design. Perfect for both enthusiasts and professionals looking to capture stunning images on the go. Explore the possibilities with the X100VI!

product_facts: it has a hybrid autofocus system
